svg.title: Structured teacher supervision
svg.desc: Structured teacher targets for challenge: repeated-session alignment and learned group fusion supply posteriors and base decisions to gated no-repeat sequence decoding. The final class is smoothed to 0.9805 for the predicted class and 0.0005 for each other class, then used to adapt the student on historical unlabeled inputs. The multimodal inset describes an independent group-precedence recipe; all teacher operations belong to weight production.
svg.text: New group labels take precedence over the sequence*.
* At trials where the new and earlier group decisions differ.
